stem: Your compute module declares `variable "instance_type" { type = string; default = "t3.micro" }`. The root module calls it without setting `instance_type`. What happens?
options: Terraform prompts interactively for the value at plan time.
Terraform uses an empty string because omitting an argument overrides the default with null.
Terraform errors because every required variable must be explicitly set by the caller.
Terraform uses `"t3.micro"` because the default applies when the caller omits the argument.
